title: Test feature-gated subresource registration via builder bool params, not OpenFeature mocking
answers: How do I write a test for whether a REST handler gets registered based on a feature flag?
Should I stub OpenFeature/memprovider in iam registry tests?
Pattern for testing conditional storage registration in UpdateUsersAPIGroup
body: register_test.go:TestUpdateUsersAPIGroup_TeamsSubresourceRequiresTeamsAPI tests gating by calling UpdateUsersAPIGroup directly with an explicit enableTeamsAPI bool and asserting on storage map keys, instead of stubbing an openfeature/memprovider. The old setTeamsApiFlag helper (in team/rest_members_test.go and user/rest_user_team_test.go) that configured an in-memory OpenFeature provider was deleted since the handlers no longer hold an ofClient/teamsAPIEnabled field to influence. Follow this pattern for any new registration-time gating: pass the flag as a function/param and assert on the resulting storage map.
applies: pkg/registry/apis/iam unit tests for API group registration
